mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id FROM attendance_heads WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND yyyymm = #{yyyymm}
SELECT status FROM attendance_heads WHERE id = #{attendanceHeadId}
SELECT yyyymm AS rejectedMonth, reject_comment AS rejectReason FROM attendance_heads WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = '2' ORDER BY yyyymm DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_heads SET status = #{status}, reject_comment = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{attendanceHeadId}
mapper.select: SELECT day AS attendance_date, kbn, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, rest_time AS breakTime, night_rest_time AS nightBreakTime, work_time AS workTime, over_time AS overTime, remarks FROM attendance_details WHERE attendance_head_id = #{attendanceHeadId} ORDER BY day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_heads ( user_id, yyyymm, status, reject_comment, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{yyyymm}, #{status}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO attendance_details ( attendance_head_id, day, kbn, start_time, end_time, rest_time, night_rest_time, work_time, over_time, remarks, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{attendanceHeadId}, SUBSTRING(#{attendance.attendanceDate}, 9, 2), #{attendance.kbn}, NULLIF(#{attendance.startTime}, ''), NULLIF(#{attendance.endTime}, ''), NULLIF(#{attendance.breakTime}, ''), NULLIF(#{attendance.nightBreakTime}, ''), NULLIF(#{attendance.workTime}, ''), NULLIF(#{attendance.overTime}, ''), #{attendance.remarks}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
